english: Siesta, where did you go…
She's surely hiding somewhere.\nCheer up, please.
I'm not depressed.\nI'm just angry at my own carelessness!
Louise-chan…
Abandoning a maid employed by a noble—\nthat's unthinkable.\nI'll find her no matter what!
Yes!\nLet's do our best together!
I searched from the air with my IS's hyper-sensor,\nbut with all these trees, it's quite difficult.
Thanks.\nWe'll have to search on foot, the slow way.
Huh? Hello, maid lady, indeed.
Oh, a wild maid spotted!\nHuh, wait?
Siesta!!
Hawa!? It's her, indeed!?
Not a wild one!!\nI mean, it was her!
Siesta? What's wrong?
…Miss Valliere is…
Huh?
…Miss Valliere is… the enemy!
Kya! What!?\nSiesta, are you angry at me?
She's acting strange!
Aoi-chan, Blue Angel!
Yes!
Siesta! What's gotten into you?
Siesta! What are THOSE!?
Wh-why is the maid lady\ncommanding monsters, indeed?
Could the mage controlling these monstrous demons\nhave been Siesta-san all along?
That's impossible!\nSiesta is a commoner—she can't use magic!
Siesta-san isn't being attacked, so\nshe's on THEIR side? Is that it?
It's strange—Siesta doesn't have that kind of power!\nWhat's going on…?
I thought I'd finish you in one strike,\nbut you dodged…
…She's not in her right mind.
Wh-what, is she a bad person!?
No. She seems to be controlled by someone.\nThis feeling… like during the soldiers' revolt\nin Southgota…?
…Miss Valliere… prepare yourself!!
Louise-san, what should I do?
I'll handle Siesta!\nEveryone else, take the others!
Understood!
Siesta! Come back to your senses!
…Miss Valliere…\nAlways, always getting in my way!
Getting in your way? What do you mean?
Putting up with things is a maid's job, but!\nOnce in a while I'll speak my mind!
Wh-what…?
For starters, you're selfish! And a crybaby!\nAnd violent! And noisy!
Are you listening properly! Louise-san!
I'm listening… just this once.
I'm telling you, you're a child! Get it?\nYou get it, right? And I don't just mean your body!
M-mm… I have to listen properly…\nright… patience, patience…
Truly, a child.\nC-h-i-l-d.
Daaah!!!!\nNope, can't do it! I can't take it!!\nI'll bring you back to your senses the rough way!!
Kyaaah!
How's that? Back to your senses yet?
…What are you talking about?\nShow-off! Stubborn!\nPancake-flat Louise-san?
Wh-wh-wh… what did you say?\nI couldn't quite hear…
Impulsive and flat-chested! Slapdash and flat-chested!\nI said you're a hotheaded flat-chest!
WHAAAT did you just say!!!!
Ohh, is that right! Yes! I heard that!\nWhatever the reason, I understand PERFECTLY\nthat you're trying to make me blow my top!!
Um, Louise-san?
Fufu, fufufu! I feel it… I feel it!\nIt's been so long… from the top of my head to my toes,\nsomething filling me up… this feeling…!!
I only stated facts.\nAny complaints?
Of course there are!!
If you have a rebuttal, go ahead. As many as you like.
Why youuuu!!
That's enough! Siesta!!
Uru surisazu ansuru ken
Gyofu nido naushizu
Eusazu yara ieru eo!!
Dispel!!
Aaaah!!
Louise-chan! What are you doing!?
Don't worry, it's not an attack spell.\nThat was Dispel—\nVoid magic that negates all magic.
…Oh? Miss Valliere?\nAre you back?
Good grief… you're the one who came back.\nWelcome home, Siesta.
What!? I was being controlled?
You don't remember at all?
Yes… though I vaguely recall\nseeing Miss Valliere's face.
Well, whatever.\nI was wrong to leave you behind on your own,\nso I have things to say, but I'll forgive you.
Haa.
Oh, and if you have something to say to me,\ndon't bottle it up—let it out sometimes.\n…Because it's scary otherwise.
I don't quite understand what you mean,\nbut if that's better, I'll do that.
One more thing.\nSiesta… do you… hate me?
Well… selfish, a crybaby,\nviolent, a show-off, stubborn,\nimpulsive…
Slapdash and short-tempered, but\nI like you, Louise-san.
…Really?
I wouldn't know this much\nabout someone I hate.
I see… well, fine.\nBut wait! Aren't you hiding something?
What?
(She left out 'flat-chested'…\nshowing mercy, huh…)
Oh, she did say 'flat-chested', didn't she?
Huh? Was I wrong…?
E-e-e…EXPLOSION!!!!
Why would you say that, indeed~…
There are good fools and bad fools,\nand this is the bad kind…
…Heightened emotion increasing magical power—\nso this phenomenon really exists.
The bearer of the Void, Louise the Zero.\nA fearsome mage who defies\nthe very concepts of mana consumption and recovery…
No wonder the client is interested.\nBut that magical power… can it be used\noutside this world?
I need to investigate a bit more.
So this is where Tefa-san\ndisappeared?
Yes, no doubt.\nA suspicious pair appeared,\nand they vanished together.
I saw it too.\nWhere could Tefa-san\nhave vanished to?
I have to find Tefa.\nTell me anything you know.
Isn't this where\nwe first came to this world?
Indeed.\nThe Blue Tears' records say so as well.
Does it have something to do with you?
I can't say anything certain yet,\nbut the phenomenon of moving to another world\nseems to occur easily at certain specific places.
It doesn't seem to always happen,\nso I doubt there's a rule to it, indeed…
But there seem to be exceptions,\nhmm, nothing's clear.\nIt bugs me.
Can we go search for Tefa?\nWe can, right?
We're currently investigating that,\nwhich is how we happened to come\nto this Halkeginia.
So if I stay with you,\nI might get to the world Tefa went to.\nThat's what you're saying, right?
I can't promise anything.\nBut they say where there's a will, there's a way!
Yes! Louise-chan feels this strongly,\nso a story where she never reunites with Tefa-chan\nsimply doesn't exist!
Right, that's no laughing matter!\nThat would be completely unacceptable!
I will absolutely save Tefa!\nAbsolutely!!
Oh my? What's this?
Huh, what?
It's all white!!
Stay here…?
We don't intend to harm you.\nAs long as you don't try to escape, your safety is guaranteed.
…Promise.
So I'm a prisoner, then.
If you think of yourself as a guest,\nwouldn't that put you at ease?
A guest…
(I could use memory-erasing magic on them\nand escape…)
(But even if I escaped, where would I go?\nAnd I don't think these people are bad…)
Understood. I'll stay here.
…Good. I'll keep the promise.
I'm relieved you're so sensible.\nAs Natchan says, we'll keep the promise.\nDon't worry.
Huh? A t-town!?
Is this an illusion?
This is apparently called Dokoka Town.\nIt's a tiny town… probably\na set from some studio!
A studio?
A set?
Umm, well… Soniko-san\njust has a unique way of putting things…
(Soniko-san is convinced this isn't real,\nthat it's all some kind of play.)
(Huh? Is that okay?)
(Won't she realize someday?)
(I'd like to get her back to her own world\nbefore that, if possible.)
(I see. If she's a civilian, it can't be helped.)
(Understood. I'll play along.)
Huh, is something wrong…?
No, we were just saying\nthat Dokoka Town is hard to explain.
Oh, true, this is a strange place.\nIt has everything…\na relaxing place, you might say…
Is that so?
Yes! Fluffy beds,\nfood… and cooking utensils—\nthey've got 'em all!
Cooking utensils too!?\nI'd love to see them!
Siesta-san, you're good at cooking♪\nOh! Then how about some ramen!
Ramen?\nWhat kind of food is that?\nI'm curious!
Um, noodles in soup…\nand especially the meat called chashu on top\nis delicious…!
Hmm… rather than explaining,\nit'd be better to show you real ramen!
Ideally I'd treat you at a good restaurant,\nbut I'll make ramen with what we have,\nso please, please try it♪
Understood!\nI'm looking forward to learning an unknown dish!
Good grief, they've hit it off.
Would you like some too, Louise-san?\nRamen is delicious.
Anything Siesta makes is delicious.\nWell, trying something unusual\nisn't bad either.
Louise-chan! Here, have this♪\nIt's a sweet called a macaron!
What, you're back already!?\nA macaron?
Munch munch…
Mmm! Sweet and delicious!
Ehehe… it's my\nfavo~rite sweet!
Hey, do they have Cookberry pie?
They seem to have lots of sweets~♪\nThere should be all kinds of pies!
I'll go look too!\nI don't really get it, but this place is amazing!
Ufufu, with good food\ngirls become friends right away.
Indeed!\nPerhaps I should show off a dish of my own?
What's the matter?
P-please, Cecilia-san, we'd love it if you\nshowed us British-style tea.\nIt's unfamiliar to us.
Indeed, tea is indispensable!\nI'll teach you\nhow to enjoy it.
Yes, please.
(Right person for the right job…)
//END
